name: @yottameta/yotta-memory
description: Yuanyi (元忆) — boundary-aware, file-based memory for AI agents. File-based, zero-dependency, diff/rollback-able; FACT/PREF/BOUND/COMMIT four types (public shared / private isolated), user-level + project-level storage; v0.9 recall quality, context focus, optional local embedding plugin, plus v0.8 semantic search, feedback loop, self-organization, and distillation.
